name: connect-database-sql-server-export-table-create
description: What: Create the ConnectExport database when it is missing (some database servers have none), then the empty SQL Server export table with the same columns as the ModelSource PData table and a primary key on Code, so Strategy SQL Server Export has a target Connect accepts. Idempotent. Why: A building block of the Connect pack; a test, setup or schedule workload runs it so its steps exist once. When: Never run directly once the pack is tested; its parents run it. Running it alone is safe only when its own Needs are met. Needs: reference values: connect/databases:ConnectExportDB, connect/databases:MasterConnectionString, connect/databases:ModelSourceDB. Success: Every step Succeeded or Skipped. If it fails: Run connect-preflight first; then open the first failed step, whose If it fails text names what to check.

inputs.name: SourceTableName
inputs.description: Source table label of the run size (PDATA), passed by the workload that runs this one.

inline.description: What: Create [{{ConnectExportDatabaseName}}] on the Main database server when it does not exist (no transaction: CREATE DATABASE cannot run in one). Why: Checks or changes the database directly, where the Profisee API has no call for it or a check must be exact. Success: The SQL finishes without an error; a THROW in the script fails the step with its own message. If it fails: Read the SQL error text first; then check the database server (connect/machines:DatabaseServerName) is reachable from this box with Windows authentication and the database named in the connection exists.
